 Summary
 Liverpool visit Fenerbahce in Champions League
 Barcola and Ngumoha start but no recognised striker in Reds XI - full team news 
 Man City travel to Leipzig and Arsenal face Slavia Prague at 20:00 GMT
 Nine games in total on Wednesday, with Real Madrid also in action 
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Sam Drury
 Most recent Most popular GOAL - AEK Athens 1-0 Real Madrid published at 18:02 GMT 18:02 GMT 
 Aboubakary Koita (12 mins) 
 AEK Athens are in front against the 15-time champions!
 The Greek side have started on the front foot with Mijat Gacinovic and Harold Moukoudi both having early chances on target, but it's a sublime finish by Aboubakary Koita that gives them the lead.
 Koita rolls the ball under his foot to cut inside and wrongfoot Marc Cucurella before lashing the ball past Thibaut Courtois.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Ngumoha too quick for Kante' published at 18:01 GMT 18:01 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 That was really positive. Rio Ngumoha has really quick feet. He's just too quick for N'Golo Kante. Clumsy challenge.
 107 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13 mins 13 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Certainly not Dominik Szoboszlai's finest free-kick. He hits it straight into the two-man Liverpool wall set up to block Ederson's view.
 16 46 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12 mins 12 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 It's got a bit scrappy in the past couple of minutes with Liverpool's progress being halted by a couple of slack passes.
 However, the visitors get a free-kick that might just being in shooting range for Dominik Szoboszlai after Rio Ngumoha, starting on the left today, jinks past a man and is then brought down.
 89 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 9 mins 9 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Alexis Mac Allister is caught in possession as Mason Greenwood snaps into a challenge but the former Manchester United man is then penalised for a push as the pair challenge for the loose ball.
 The home fans did not like that decision.
 151 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:55 GMT 17:55 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Does Guendouzi make that list Bert?
 Ross 
 37 63 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 7 mins 7 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Fenerbahce's first chance to get men forward comes with a throw-in on the right.
 They launch it long into the box but Virgil van Dijk heads it away and Liverpool try to break through Victor Munoz.
 He's well marshalled by left-back Archie Brown, though, and ends up giving away a free-kick for a shove on the Fenerbahce man.
 24 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Jacquet should do a lot better' published at 17:53 GMT 17:53 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Ally McCoist 
Former Scotland striker on TNT Sports 
 Jeremy Jacquet does really well. His movement is good. He comes in behind and I think he should probably do better. A lot better.
 99 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Big chances for Liverpool published at 17:53 GMT 17:53 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 Two big chances for Liverpool in the first five minutes.
 There's constant jeers from the Fenerbahce fans whenever Liverpool have the ball. It is very loud but the early signs are that this is the way the game will go.
 108 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'What a chance' published at 17:53 GMT 17:53 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on MOTD: UEFA Champions League 
 Jacquet should score. What a chance that was.
 You can hear more from Warnock on MOTD: Uefa Champions League at 22:40 BST on BBC One and the BBC Sport website and app. 
 67 25 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 4 mins 4 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 The initial corner is cleared but the ball is put back into the box and Jeremy Jacquet meets it in the middle.
 Good chance but he doesn't get enough on the header and it slides wide.
 74 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 3 mins 3 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 First chance of the game falls to Liverpool.
 Kostas Tsmikas' cross comes through to Victor Munoz in plenty of space, he completes scuffs his shot but the ball comes back to him as Bradley Barcola fails to divert the ball goalwards.
 Much better effort this time from Munoz and Ederson has to push it around the post.
 124 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:49 GMT 17:49 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Look at al these cult heroes in the Fenerbahce squad! N’golo Kante, Lukaku, Ederson… this list just goes on!
 Bert 
 Image source, Getty Images

 Post published at 2 mins 2 mins 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Liverpool are content to knock the ball around at the back and ease themselves in early on. Fenerbahce are equally happy to let them do so, it seems.

 KICK-OFF published at 17:47 GMT 17:47 GMT 
 Fenerbahce 0-0 Liverpool 
 Liverpool kick-off and away we go!

 Fenerbahce v Liverpool (17:45 GMT) 
 Before kick-off there is a moment's silence for Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel following his tragic death on Monday.
 Image source, Getty Images

 Post published at 17:45 GMT 17:45 GMT 
 Fenerbahce v Liverpool (17:45 GMT) 
 Kick-off is just a few moments away so here is a reminder of how we expect the teams to line up...
 Image source, BBC/ Opta Image source, BBC/ Opta 
 82 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 17:44 GMT 17:44 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Really arrogant comment from Noah (17:22). Liverpool have never ever won in Turkey with their first choice eleven. I would argue that they are 2nd favourites tonight even with their first eleven. Games in Turkey are never easy and Fenerbahce have some really good players.
 Rik 
 103 162 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 17:44 GMT 17:44 GMT 
 Fenerbahce v Liverpool (17:45 GMT) 
 Here come the players, the rain is teeming down but the stadium is bouncing for what promises to be an intriguing game.
 On recent form, Liverpool should be clear favourites but their record in Turkey shows that it may not be quite that simple...
 58 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Kuyt in the dugout published at 17:42 GMT 17:42 GMT 
 Fenerbahce v Liverpool (17:45 GMT) 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter in Istanbul 
 This Fenerbahce side has over 1,000 Premier League appearances between them and are of course coached by former Liverpool man Dirk Kuyt tonight. 
 Kuyt is only the interim after Ismail Kartal resigned last week. Fenerbahce actually appointed a new manager last night and it's former Newcastle player Emre who will take over the reigns after this game. Quite a lot going on in Istanbul!
